title: Basilisk Oil
summary: Ends Petrified on another creature. Administer the oil or throw it. You cannot drink it yourself.

fields.Administer: Bonus Action. Administer to a nearby Petrified creature.
fields.Throw: Action. Throw up to 60 ft to restore Petrified creatures within 3 ft of impact.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
